from solution import remove_even


def test_issue_example_python():
    """Example: remove_even("python") == "pto"."""
    assert remove_even("python") == "pto"  # keep 0:p,2:t,4:o -> "pto"


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Empty input gives empty output per keep-even-indices rule."""
    assert remove_even("") == ""  # no indices to keep -> ""


def test_issue_single_char():
    """Single char keeps index 0 per remove-odd-indices rule."""
    assert remove_even("a") == "a"  # keep 0:a -> "a"


def test_issue_two_chars():
    """Two chars keep only index 0 per remove-odd-indices rule."""
    assert remove_even("ab") == "a"  # keep 0:a, drop 1:b -> "a"


def test_issue_three_chars():
    """Three chars keep indices 0 and 2 per rule."""
    assert remove_even("abc") == "ac"  # keep 0:a,2:c -> "ac"


def test_issue_four_chars_even_length():
    """Even length 4 keeps indices 0 and 2 per rule."""
    assert remove_even("abcd") == "ac"  # keep 0:a,2:c -> "ac"


def test_issue_five_chars_odd_length():
    """Odd length 5 keeps indices 0, 2 and 4 per rule."""
    assert remove_even("abcde") == "ace"  # keep 0:a,2:c,4:e -> "ace"


def test_issue_six_chars():
    """Length 6 keeps indices 0, 2 and 4 per rule."""
    assert remove_even("abcdef") == "ace"  # keep 0:a,2:c,4:e -> "ace"


def test_issue_with_spaces():
    """Spaces are characters too, filter by index per rule."""
    assert remove_even("a b c") == "abc"  # keep 0:a,2:b,4:c -> "abc"


def test_issue_with_digits():
    """Digits are filtered by index not by numeric value per rule."""
    assert remove_even("a1b2c3") == "abc"  # keep 0:a,2:b,4:c -> "abc"


def test_contract_returns_str():
    """Contract: example result "pto" is a string so return must be str."""
    assert isinstance(remove_even("python"), str)


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Contract: function returns a new string and leaves input unchanged."""
    s = "python"
    remove_even(s)
    assert s == "python"  # input unchanged -> "python"
